01In February 2026 we successfully commissioned a BC 10 SBR wastewater treatment plant for a nursery…

In February 2026 we successfully commissioned a BC 10 SBR wastewater treatment plant for a nursery school. It is a modern solution based on SBR (Sequencing Batch Reactor) technology, complemented by the new online remote management and monitoring system – AQUAVISOR.

02Modern technology with minimal operating demands

Modern technology with minimal operating demands

At the heart of the plant is highly efficient SBR technology with a built-in sludge tank, which provides intensive biological treatment in a single functional zone. As a result, the need for desludging is greatly reduced and operation remains stable even under fluctuating hydraulic and pollutant loads.

03An ideal solution for nurseries and buildings in irregular use

An ideal solution for nurseries and buildings in irregular use

The BC 10 SBR plant is designed with irregular water consumption in mind, which is typical of nursery schools, schools and seasonally used buildings. Its large coarse-debris trap copes easily even with unsuitable items in the sewage, such as wet wipes.

SBR technology is also exceptionally resilient to fluctuations in inflow. Trial operation at a certified testing facility confirmed that the plant can fully reactivate even after a shutdown of up to six months, which also makes it an ideal solution for cabins, cottages and holiday properties that are used for only part of the year.

04Thanks to the AQUAVISOR system, both the operator and the service technician have a continuous overview of how the technology is running…

Thanks to the AQUAVISOR system, both the operator and the service technician have a continuous overview of how the technology is running, along with remote diagnostics and the ability to respond in good time to abnormal operating states. This significantly increases operational reliability and reduces servicing costs
